scope: Read-only aggregate Website assignment and order-source metadata; no customer rows, stock or assignments changed
query:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'productCount',(select count(*) from public.products),
 'publishedProductCount',(select count(*) from public.products where published is true),
 'publishedWithAnyWebsiteListing',(select count(*) from public.products p where p.published is true and exists(select 1 from public.channel_listings l where l.sku=p.sku and l.channel_source in ('website','website_retail','website_vip'))),
 'websiteListingStates',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x) from (select channel_source,status,publication_status,count(*) as listing_count from public.channel_listings where channel_source in ('website','website_retail','website_vip') group by channel_source,status,publication_status order by channel_source,status,publication_status) x),'[]'::jsonb),
 'duplicateNormalizedWebsiteSkus',(select count(*) from (select sku from public.channel_listings where channel_source in ('website','website_retail','website_vip') group by sku having count(*)>1) x),
 'canonicalChannelTablePresent',to_regclass('public.channels') is not null,
 'canonicalShopTablePresent',to_regclass('public.channel_shops') is not null,
 'liveOrderWriters',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'referencesChannelListings',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ilike '%channel_listings%','referencesPublished',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ilike '%published%','referencesShippingAmount',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ilike '%shipping_amount%')) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('submit_order_request_v2','submit_guest_order_v1')),'[]'::jsonb)
) as website_membership_preflight;
